subject: [PATCH 4/4] kernfs: Remove kernfs_rwsem from dentry revalidation

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch removes the kernfs_rwsem lock from dentry revalidation in the Linux kernel's kernfs subsystem. The lock was previously taken to ensure a coherent snapshot, but it is no longer necessary as the answer returned by ->d_revalidate() is already stale when it returns. The patch replaces the lock with an RCU read lock and uses data_race() to mark reads that are not protected by the lock. This change reduces contention sites in kernfs_dop_revalidate() and improves performance for readers walking cgroupfs and sysfs against concurrent cgroup and netdev churn.
